name: Trelane's Phylactery
summary: Trelane’s Phylactery is one of three objects sought from the tower in Arathi Highlands. Skuerto at Refuge Pointe asks you to bring it back with Trelane’s Orb and Trelane’s Ember Agate.

sections.title: The Tower’s Chests
sections.body: Skuerto at Refuge Pointe sends you to find Trelane’s Phylactery in the tower. Trelane’s Orb and Trelane’s Ember Agate are there as well, kept in chests among the ogres. Bring all three objects back, and Malin will hear of your success.

faq.q: Where do I find Trelane’s Phylactery?
faq.answer: Trelane’s Phylactery is in a chest inside the tower in Arathi Highlands.
Skuerto at Refuge Pointe asks you to bring Trelane’s Phylactery back with Trelane’s Orb and Trelane’s Ember Agate.

faq.q: What else is in the tower’s chests?
faq.answer: Trelane’s Orb and Trelane’s Ember Agate are also kept in chests inside the tower.

faq.q: Why does Skuerto want these objects?
faq.answer: Skuerto says Malin will be pleased when you return with Trelane’s Phylactery, Trelane’s Orb and Trelane’s Ember Agate.
